company.shortDescription: Sarwa is a financial platform and app that lets you easily trade stocks and ETFs, save and invest your money passively all in one place.
company.description: Sarwa is a financial technology company that operates a digital investment and wealth management platform that offers automated investing, self-directed stock and ETF trading, cryptocurrency services, and cash savings products. Its services are available through mobile and web applications targeted primarily at users in the Middle East.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $15,000,000, or 51.9% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,390,764 to $109,301,543, a 45.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
